description: Search the live product catalog of Baqer Store (باقر ستور, Iraq) by text in Arabic or English (e.g. "تابلت للأطفال", "شاحن سامسونج سريع", "iPhone 15"), category, brand and price range in Iraqi dinars (IQD). Returns up to 20 products with name, brand, current price in IQD, previous price when discounted, stock status, product page URL and image. In-stock products come first. Use get_product for full details and order_link to order. For VIP phone numbers use search_vip_numbers.

max_price_iqd.description: Highest price in Iraqi dinars, e.g. 150000.

query.description: What the customer is looking for, Arabic or English. Optional if category or brand is given.

name: search_products
title: Search Baqer Store products
